newsitem.title: EU: EP WOMEN'S RIGHTS COMMITTEE AGENDA - APRIL 16-17.
newsitem.headline: EP WOMEN'S RIGHTS COMMITTEE AGENDA - APRIL 16-17.

text.p: Wednesday, 16 April 1997 3.00 p.m. 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 220.963 ) 2. Chairperson's announcements 3. Reports by Committee Members on the activities of other Committees of which they are Members In the presence of the Commission 3.15 p.m. 4.
